name: Peter Michael

residences.note: 1790 census 'Peter Michel': 1 male over 16, 1 under 16, 4 females (per WikiTree)

bioAdditions: Peter Michael (Michel) married Maria Elisabeth Grub (b. 5 Jun 1761, living 1826), daughter of Andreas Grub, whose 1791 will names 'Elizabeth the wife of Peter Michael'. In 1790 his Forks Township household had one man over 16, one boy and four females. Elizabeth Michael was still living in 1826, when her brother-in-law Gottlieb Hipp's will named her (S1).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Named in Andreas Grub's will (via WikiTree transcription); 1790 census household.
